# Quote — Juniper Lane Dental

**From:** Bluewick IT | **To:** Mary Major, Office Manager | **Valid:** 30 days from issue

## Summary

You asked for new PCs, proper Wi-Fi, backups that support your HIPAA obligations, and monthly support, with a project budget of about $15,000. The full one-off scope comes to **$18,844.50**, so we've split it into two phases. **Phase 1 ($14,933.25)** fixes the urgent items first — backup, firewall and Wi-Fi — and replaces 7 of the 10 staff PCs. **Phase 2 ($3,911.25)** replaces the remaining 3 when budget allows. Recurring services are **$1,195/month plus $420/year**.

## Scope — Phase 1

1. **Backup and recovery (priority).** Your last successful backup was four months ago and the practice-management database holds patient records. We install an on-site backup appliance plus encrypted off-site cloud backup, run nightly, with a documented test restore. Bluewick and the cloud vendor both sign a BAA. This supports your HIPAA obligations.
2. **Network.** Business firewall with security subscription, 24-port managed PoE switch (replacing the 8-port unmanaged one), and three access points giving full coverage with separate staff and guest Wi-Fi.
3. **Workstations.** Seven staff PCs replaced, data and profiles migrated, existing monitors reused.
4. **Managed support** for 11 users (recurring, below).

**Not in Phase 1:** the remaining 3 staff PCs (Phase 2) and the 2 operatory imaging PCs (see Phase 3 below).

## One-off costs — Phase 1

| Item | Qty | Unit price | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Business PC (i5, 16 GB, 512 GB SSD) | 7 | $960.00 | $6,720.00 |
| Wi-Fi access point | 3 | $349.00 | $1,047.00 |
| Firewall appliance | 1 | $640.00 | $640.00 |
| 24-port managed PoE switch | 1 | $720.00 | $720.00 |
| Backup appliance | 1 | $1,200.00 | $1,200.00 |
| **Hardware subtotal** | | | **$10,327.00** |
| PC deployment & data migration (2.5 h/PC) | 17.5 h | $125.00 | $2,187.50 |
| Network install | 10 h | $125.00 | $1,250.00 |
| Backup setup & test restore | 6 h | $125.00 | $750.00 |
| Project management (10% of labour) | | | $418.75 |
| **Labour subtotal** | | | **$4,606.25** |
| **Phase 1 total (excl. sales tax)** | | | **$14,933.25** |

## Recurring services

| Service | Qty | Monthly | Annual |
|---|---|---|---|
| Managed support | 11 users × $95 | $1,045.00 | $12,540.00 |
| Encrypted cloud backup (vendor signs BAA) | 1 | $150.00 | $1,800.00 |
| Firewall security subscription (billed annually) | 1 | — | $420.00 |
| **Total** | | **$1,195.00/mo** | **$14,760.00/yr** |

## Options and recommendation

| Option | One-off cost | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **A. Full scope now** | $18,844.50 | $3,844.50 over budget; one disruption |
| **B. Two phases (recommended)** | Phase 1: $14,933.25 / Phase 2: $3,911.25 | Phase 2 = 3 PCs ($2,880), 7.5 h deployment ($937.50), PM ($93.75) |
| **C. Phase 3 — imaging PCs** | Not quoted | SensorView v6 is certified only on vendor-specified hardware; we'll obtain the spec and sign-off, then quote |

**We recommend Option B.** It fits your budget; all the risk reduction (backup, firewall, segmented Wi-Fi) happens now; and the three deferred PCs are working today, so the only cost of waiting is time. Phasing adds no labour cost because deployment is priced per PC. We'll replace the seven oldest or slowest machines first. Phase 2 prices are indicative and will be confirmed when ordered.

On acceptance, we'll install the cloud backup agent on the practice-management host within a few days — before the rest of the hardware arrives — so you aren't unprotected while we wait on delivery.

## Assumptions and exclusions

- Prices exclude sales tax. Hardware carries manufacturer warranty.
- Monitors, keyboards and mice are reused. PCs include Windows Pro; Microsoft 365 and other software licences are not included.
- Existing cabling is suitable for the switch, APs and PCs. New cable runs are billed at $125/h plus materials.
- The practice-management database stays on its current host; backup covers it. Practice-management and imaging vendor fees are excluded.
- Imaging PCs, printers, phones and ISP service changes are excluded.
- Managed support covers 11 users and all 12 PCs, billed monthly.

## Terms

- Quote valid 30 days.
- 50% deposit on Phase 1 hardware (**$5,163.50**) on acceptance; balance (**$9,769.75**) on completion.
- Recurring services billed monthly; firewall subscription billed annually in advance.
- Bluewick will sign a Business Associate Agreement before accessing any patient data.

---

## Cover email

**Subject:** Bluewick IT quote — Juniper Lane Dental

Hi Mary,

Thanks for having us in. The quote is attached.

Two things from the site visit. First, the last successful backup was four months ago, and the patient database is on that system — this is the most urgent item, so we've put it first and can start cloud backup within days of acceptance. Second, you have 12 PCs, not 10: the two operatory imaging PCs can only be replaced on hardware the imaging vendor approves, so we've left them out until we have that sign-off.

The full scope is $18,845. To stay near your $15,000 budget, we recommend doing backup, firewall, Wi-Fi and seven PCs now ($14,933), and the last three PCs ($3,911) later. Monthly support and cloud backup are $1,195/month plus $420/year.

Happy to walk through it on a call.

Best,
[Name], Bluewick IT

---

## Internal note — to owner

**Pricing:** Every hardware line on our list is below the 25% margin policy (PC 19.9%, switch 22.7%, AP 23.3%, firewall 23.7%, backup 24.4%) — it looks like 25% markup on cost, not margin on sell. I've repriced this quote to the 25% floor (+$682 vs list on full scope). Please confirm or fix the list before anything goes out.

**Scope:** 12 PCs, not 10; imaging PCs excluded pending SensorView vendor sign-off. Backup has failed for four months on patient data — I've offered day-one cloud backup.

**Wording:** Mary wrote "HIPAA compliant"; quote says "supports HIPAA obligations" per policy.
